rows.title_full: AN ACT REDUCING THE USE OF PLASTIC BAGS, STYROFOAM CONTAINERS, DISPOSABLE PLASTIC UTENSILS, AND SIMILAR ITEMS IN ALL ESTABLISHMENTS IN THE COUNTRY
rows.title_short: “Plastic Bag Reduction Act”
rows.abstract: “Plastic Bag Reduction Act”.  The bill prohibits commercial establishments from a) providing their customers any plastic bag free of charge, b) the use of plastic bags thinner than 20 microns, and c) the use of styrofoam containers and plastic utensils.  It also mandates commercial establishments to include the cost of the plastic bag, should the customer request for one, in the official receipt of the customer.

rows.abstract: “Basic Education Service Contracting Act”.  The bill provides for the basic education services that may be availed of by the government to include the following:  a) instructional services of private schools, b) private management/supervision of certain public schools, c) private-public partnership for school building, and d) educational assessment and monitoring.

rows.title_short: “The Pregnancy Care Centers Act of 2006”
rows.abstract: “The Pregnancy Care Centers Act of 2006”.  The bill seeks the establishment of pregnancy health care centers  that will provide pregnancy testing, pregnancy confirmation through ultrasound, mentoring and nurturing support, linkage to community resources, education, material aid, housing referral, abstinence education for unmarried persons and natural family planning for married couples who wish to postpone pregnancy.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on POPULATION AND FAMILY RELATIONS since 2006-03-07

rows.title_short: “National Emergency Act of 2006”
rows.abstract: “National Emergency Act of 2006”.  The bill seeks to define the policies, principles and procedure for the declaration of a state of national emergency.
